caption:
Google's Gemini 4 Argon just set a new record on real coding work, and you're not allowed to use it yet 🔒

Google DeepMind built its strongest model so far, then held it back. Trusted cyber defenders get it first. Paid API customers and Google AI Ultra subscribers are next.

→ 77.9% on DeepSWE, a new state of the art on long coding tasks
→ top score on Zapier's AutomationBench for business tasks
→ up to 1 million output tokens in one answer (was 64K)
→ intro API price: $2 in, $10 out per million tokens

Comment ARGON and I'll DM you the rollout order + a day-one prompt to stress-test that 1M output 📩

Would you pay for Ultra to get it first? Yes or no?

Save this for the day it opens up, and send it to the dev who lives in Gemini.

captions.facebook:
Google built its strongest AI model yet, then locked it away from almost everyone.

Google's new Gemini 4 model set a new state of the art on long real-world coding tasks (77.9% on DeepSWE) and ranks first on Zapier's AutomationBench for business work. It can also write up to 1 million tokens in a single answer, up from 64K.

But you can't use it yet. Google DeepMind is giving it to trusted cyber defenders first. Paid API customers and Google AI Ultra subscribers come next, everyone else "as soon as possible".

→ Now: cyber defenders in Google's Fairwind Program
→ Next: paid API users + AI Ultra subscribers
→ Later: developers, enterprises and consumers

Is holding a model back for security the right call, or just hype? What do you think?

#gemini #aicoding #ainews
